source_note: Prototype duty-based match (not official concordance): O*NET Software Developers (design/test applications) vs JSA/ABS ANZSCO 261313 Software Engineers (design/develop/test software). Scope is broader on O*NET side; alternative ANZSCO 261312 may also apply. https://www.onetonline.org/link/summary/15-1252.00 ; https://www.jobsandskills.gov.au/data/occupation-and-industry-profiles/occupations-anzsco/261313-software-engineers

Prototype duty-based match (not official concordance): O*NET Web Developers (develop and maintain websites and web applications) vs ANZSCO 261212 Web Developer. https://www.onetonline.org/link/summary/15-1254.00 ; https://www.acs.org.au/msa/information-for-applicants/occupations-anzsco-codes/information-technology.html

Prototype duty-based match (not official concordance): O*NET Computer Systems Analysts (analyze systems, improve integration) vs ANZSCO 261112 Systems Analyst. https://www.onetonline.org/link/summary/15-1211.00 ; https://www.acs.org.au/msa/information-for-applicants/occupations-anzsco-codes/information-technology.html

Approximate prototype match (not official concordance): O*NET Computer Network Architects (design/plan networks) vs ANZSCO 263111 Computer Network and Systems Engineer (design/implement/manage networks). Australian role includes systems engineering beyond network architecture. https://www.onetonline.org/link/summary/15-1241.00 ; https://www.acs.org.au/msa/information-for-applicants/occupations-anzsco-codes/information-technology.html
